text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 54, September 14, 1936 ]
DOMESTIC CONSUMPTION AND EMERGENCY RESERVE SUGAR ALLOTMENTS FOR 1937
Pursuant to authority vested in me by Act Numbered Four thousand one hundred sixty-six of the Tenth
Philippine Legislature, entitled “An Act to provide for the limitation, regulation, and allocation of sugar
production in the Philippine Islands, and for the processing and marketing thereof, and for other purposes,” it
is hereby ordered that:
1. (a) The Philippine 1937 quota of sugar for domestic consumption shall be 90,915.3356 short tons, net
weight, which includes the mill district domestic allotment of 4,838.3640 short tons determined as necessary
for Rosario Sugar Mills in accordance with the second paragraph of section 8 of Act No. 4166.
(b) The Philippine 1937 quota of sugar for emergency reserve shall be 58,923.0284 short tons, net weight.
